symptom.statement: Product Director produced a B2B-CARGA-002 review that required a separately executed artifact before Quality; the UI baseline has three steps while a rule candidate proposes four. The initial router-return gap is now patched and the candidate artifact is generated.

immediate_cause.statement: The product review and the B2B wizard rule are separate levels of authority. Without a bounded executable contract and test readback, the Router cannot safely present a verified executor artifact to Quality.

systemic_root_cause.statement: A candidate four-state UI proposal is not reconciled against the current three-step screen contract, while the execution pipeline historically lacked an executable product-to-repair handoff. The pipeline contract is repaired, but business-rule promotion remains separate.

causal_chain.statement: Product Director parent execution completed 11/11, emitted PRODUCT_EXECUTOR_HANDOFF and persisted REENTER_ROUTER_STAGE1.
ACT-0001 selected the canonical SRCR repair profile with governed_repair_write, scope B2B-CARGA-002 and no_promotion=true.
The SRCR-produced sandbox candidate JSON and eight executable unit regressions merged through PR #3972; neither screen nor rules were mutated.

first_bad_control.statement: The first missing evidence boundary was a source-state reconciliation and executable negative-test package for B2B-CARGA-002; the candidate alone cannot acquire currentness or authorise implementation.

escape_control.statement: Quality must not accept a Product Director inventory or an unexecuted proposal; the receiver requires a GitHub artifact and actual test/readback evidence before entry.
